exact_claim_text: Within the synthetic case, scanning became routine only after alert ownership and exception handling were integrated into the workflow; tool enablement alone produced repeated bypasses.
method_or_source: Triangulation across configuration snapshots, issue records, meeting notes, policy documents and illustrative interviews, including discrepant evidence.
uncertainty: Synthetic case, selective records, bounded period and dependence on the declared case boundary.
boundary: One synthetic laboratory, one 12-week period and one workflow; analytic, not statistical, generalisation.
counter_evidence_or_alternative: One team continued to bypass the scanner after the common workflow was introduced.
stronger_wording_rejected: Automated dependency scanning succeeds whenever a tool is enabled.
